passage:
The gardener planted flowers near the school gate. For the first week, students stepped over them carelessly and some flowers broke.
The gardener did not scold anyone. He placed a small sign beside the flowers: "We are new here. Please help us grow."
Students began walking more carefully. Some even watered the flowers when the weather was dry.
By spring, the gate was full of color. Many students took photos there.
A teacher said the sign worked because it made the flowers sound alive and young. Students did not only see plants. They saw something that needed protection.
The right words can change how people treat the same place.
